description: 1. Read SKILL.md to discover the overall workflow and the reference to `references/openclaw.md`. 2. Read `references/openclaw.md` to discover the exact 4 canonical personas: Aurelius/oc-001/Wellness, Cassian/oc-002/Finance, Vesper/oc-003/Social, Solenne/oc-004/Spiritual — along with the required agents-config.json format and qlog metric types. 3. Create `skills/life-control/references/agents-config.json` with all 4 personas using exact agent IDs, names, and domains from openclaw.md. 4. Run `skills/life-control/scripts/bootstrap.sh` which calls setup-agents.sh, which reads agents-config.json and calls `lc register` for each — resulting in all 4 agents in the DB. 5. Verify with `lc fleet` that all 4 are active. 6. Use `lc add <agent_id> '<goal title>' [--priority ...]` for each of the 4 agent IDs (oc-001 through oc-004). 7. Use `qlog <metric_type> <value> --agent <agent_id>` with at least 3 distinct metric types from the allowed set (protein, water, workout, expense, meditate) — using wrong metric names will fail due to CLI validation. 8. Run at least one routine: `bash skills/life-control/routines/<routine>.sh <agent_id>` which produces a log file in `logs/<agent_id>-<routine>.log`. 9. Run `lc notify <agent_id> '<message>'` to produce a queue file at `db/notify-queue-<agent_id>.txt`.
